**Resident Routines**
*   **Felix:** Weekdays: Home mornings; out 13:40–23:00. Weekends: Off; errands midday. Hobbies: Movies, houseplants.
*   **Aisha:** Weekdays: WFH 09:00–17:30; sometimes out for lunch. Weekends: Sleeps in; errands midday. Hobbies: Friends, meditation, movies.
*   **Ines:** Weekdays: WFH 09:00–17:30; sometimes out for lunch. Weekends: Sleeps in; errands midday. Hobbies: Baking, reading, running.

**Object Locations & Patterns**
*   **Felix’s Items:**
    *   *Backpack, Jacket, Scarf, Shoes, Water Bottle, Umbrella:* Entry (hook/floor) when home. Taken out ~14:00, returned ~23:00 (work).
    *   *Keys, Wallet, Sunglasses:* Entry table when home. Taken out ~14:00, returned ~23:00. Note: Wallet moved to desk_b1 at 23:00.
    *   *Phone:* Nightstand_b1 when home. Carried out ~10:00, returned ~23:00.
    *   *Tablet, Glasses, Book, Pen:* Bedroom 1 (nightstand/desk).
    *   *Razor, Medication:* Bathroom (medicine cabinet/shelf).
    *   *Towel:* Bathroom (towel rack).
    *   *Dishes (Plate, Mug, Glass, Bowl):* Kitchen (cupboard) by 23:00.

*   **Aisha’s Items:**
    *   *Jacket, Scarf, Shoes, Umbrella:* Entry (hook/floor) when home. Taken out ~12:00, returned ~12:38 (weekend errand).
    *   *Keys, Wallet:* Entry table when home. Taken out ~12:00, returned ~12:38.
    *   *Phone:* Nightstand_b2 when home. Carried out ~08:00, returned ~00:00 (next day).
    *   *Laptop:* Bedroom 2 (desk/nightstand).
    *   *Headphones, Mug, Pen, Book:* Bedroom 2 (desk/nightstand/floor).
    *   *Meditation Cushion:* Bedroom 2 floor.
    *   *Razor, Skincare, Medication:* Bathroom (shelf/medicine cabinet).
    *   *Towel:* Bathroom (towel rack).
    *   *Dishes (Plate, Mug, Glass, Bowl):* Kitchen (cupboard) by 23:00.

*   **Ines’s Items:**
    *   *Running Shoes:* Entry shoe rack. Removed ~19:00, returned ~19:00 (run).
    *   *Keys, Jacket, Scarf, Sunglasses:* Entry (table/hook). Removed ~18:00, returned ~19:00 (errand/run).
    *   *Headphones, Laptop, Mug, Pen, Water Bottle, Book:* Bedroom 3 (desk/nightstand).
    *   *Phone:* Nightstand_b3 when home. Carried out ~08:00, returned ~20:00.
    *   *Skincare:* Bathroom shelf.
    *   *Towel:* Bathroom towel rack.
    *   *Dishes (Plate, Mug, Glass, Bowl):* Kitchen (cupboard) by 23:00.

*   **Shared Items:**
    *   *Kitchen Tools (Knife, Spatula, Pan, Pot, Cutting Board, Recipe Book):* Cycle between counter, sink, drawer, cupboard, and pantry. Generally stored in cupboard/drawer by 23:00.
    *   *Watering Can, Gardening Gloves:* Balcony.
